Happy Clerical Day, NYC! 🗓️

While public school kids enjoy a day off and teachers catch up on paperwork, NYC DOE students are only getting ~1,200 instructional hours per year.

Meanwhile, students in Success Academy, the city’s largest charter network, get closer to 1,400. A KIPP NYC student receives nearly 1,500.

Over the course of a single school year, charter school students receive the equivalent of more than a month of additional instruction.
